shorts.title: What Keelson is
shorts.problem: What is Keelson, and what does it keep on your machine?

shorts.title: First run
shorts.problem: What does Keelson put on your machine, how do you know it is healthy, and what happens when you talk to it?

shorts.title: Chat three ways
shorts.problem: If you can talk to the agent from the browser, a terminal, and a script, where does the conversation actually live?

shorts.title: A place to work
shorts.problem: Where does agent work happen, and how does the next chat know what the last one learned?

shorts.title: First workflow
shorts.problem: What does it mean to take the control flow away from the agent, and what does a run leave behind?

shorts.title: Write a workflow
shorts.problem: How do you turn work you want done the same way every time into something Keelson can check and run?

shorts.title: The approval gate
shorts.problem: How do you keep an agent from taking a step you can't undo until a person says yes?

shorts.title: Many models
shorts.problem: Which model should do which job, and how do you find out without arguing about it?

shorts.title: Issue to draft PR
shorts.problem: How do you hand an agent real code work without letting it loose on your checkout?

shorts.title: Make it remember
shorts.problem: How does a fresh session learn what an earlier run found, without an unattended run teaching it something wrong?

shorts.title: Where the tokens went
shorts.problem: After all that work, which turns spent what, on which model, and what did it cost?

shorts.title: The rib model
shorts.problem: How do you add capability to Keelson without changing Keelson?

shorts.title: Add a capability
shorts.problem: What does it take to give Keelson a capability it didn't ship with?

shorts.title: Plan the backlog
shorts.problem: How do you hand agents a build the way a team would work it, one ready unit at a time?

shorts.title: The software factory
shorts.problem: Something has to work the board the way a team would, with someone else reading every change before it lands.

shorts.title: Your agent drives it
shorts.problem: How does the coding agent you already use reach Keelson's workflows and ribs?

shorts.title: No paid keys
shorts.problem: Can Keelson run on a model you host yourself, with no account and no key?

shorts.title: Ask for a report
shorts.problem: How does a chat answer become a designed page someone will read, keep, or share?

shorts.title: Did that change help?
shorts.problem: When you change a workflow's prompt, how do you know it got better and not just different?

shorts.title: Shorts, by Keelson
shorts.problem: How do you make every short the same way, and still have a person decide what ships?
